nom: DUNE SUNCARE The Mug Guard Broad Spectrum SPF 30

avis.texte: This is the first time I've went out of my way to repurchase a sunscreen. This gel sunscreen is super easy to rub in, it doesn't leave any tackiness on the skin or a whitecast. It's very lightweight and hydrating. If you let it sit on your face long enough, it would work wonderfully under makeup. It's so easy to use, it turned me into a habitual sunscreen wearer. Love this stuff.
If you want an effective but lightweight sunscreen this is it. Absorbs easily and no greasy feel at all. 10-10

This is my favorite sunscreen. It leaves my skin hydrated without being greasy or heavy. I love how light this feels and that I don't need to worry about white cast! Highly recommend, I will buy again and again!
This sunscreen blends effortlessly and doesn't leave a white cast, it's completely invisible! Not greasy or sticky and lightweight. I'll always carry this in my beach bag!
Super lightweight and doesn't feel greasy. Absorbs fast and doesn't leave a white cast. Really easy to wear every day.

This is the first sunscreen I actually look forward to putting on every morning. It goes on completely clear and feels weightless. Even though the bottle is compact, the quality of the formula justifies every penny.
Makes my skin feel great and hydrated. I love how a little goes a long way. So worth it. I love it.
It does not leave my face oily and I love how it is safe for reefs. This is always a must have when in the sun, especially on days I am in the ocean.
This is under my makeup every single day. I couldn't go outside without it!
Lightweight and comfortable with solid sun protection. It blends in easily without feeling heavy and gives a nice natural finish. Great for everyday use and easy to reapply throughout the day.
I'm not kidding when I say, this is my go to spf for my face. It literally feels like skincare and not just an additional step in my routine. It gives me that final glow of my routine that I needed
I absolutely love this sunscreen, my skin is very sensitive, this one is lightweight and feels so calming as well. This definitely made it top my top 5 sunscreen. Is rosacea friendly by the way

I've been searching for the perfect face sunscreen to top off my routine for years. The mug guard goes on smoothly, doesn't pill or leave any cast, and does t cause any issues for my sensitive skin. 10/10!!
this sunscreen works so well and I love how much it reduces redness yet looks invisible on the skin 1000/10 would recommend

avis.titre: Do I even have sunscreen on? YES!
avis.texte: I LOVE this sunscreen. Feels like I don't have anything on but I know I am in fact protecting my skin! It blends in effortlessly, no irritation to eyes, and makes my skin feel soft & dewy. Been looking FOREVER for the perfect daily sunscreen and I finally found it!
I liked that it doesn't feel heavy on the face and the liquid consistency. The smell is not strong and protected my skin all day

avis.titre: My go to sunscreen for myself and my family
avis.texte: I love Dune sunscreen. I have several skin conditions. Rosacea, eczema, PML, acne. This is one of the few sunscreens that I can reapply all day and not get break outs or reactions from. While I do wish the spf was a bit higher this is an exellent every day choice to add with a hat, sun glasses, UV protective clothing to limit skin damage. Its slender bottle shape makes it easy to carry around. I hope they make a lip balm sunscreen soon 😊.

Dune is the best - all of their packaging looks adorable in my beach bag, purse, and on my shelf. The Mug Guard is where it's at. I love that it's moisturizing and hydrating and made from mineral ingredients without making me look like a ghost. Love that it doesn't have a bunch of creepy chemicals and that it's barrier reef safe :)

avis.titre: a gel facial sunscreen that's reef safe, too?! A dream
avis.texte: this feels so nice and my skin is visibly more nourished and glowy when I use it regularly. The texture feels so nice I actually look forward to reapplying (didn't think that was possible)! Love

avis.titre: gel facial sunscreen that's reef safe too?! a dream
avis.texte: My skin looks and feels SO much better when I use this regularly. It melts in instantly and feels super nourishing, I actually look forward to reapplying (which I never thought possible)!
I have sensitive skin and this is one of the best sunscreens I've ever tried. The best part is that it doesn't leave my skin oily or sticky. I love it!
The best sunscreen I've ever used! It's lightweight, hydrating, and doesn't leave a white cast. It's a gel and dries down super quickly so I never feel sticky. Plus it's reef safe!

This sunscreen feels amazing on my sensitive skin. I've tried so many brands in the past and ended up with itchy hives on my cheeks, but now my skin is clear. I also love that it's vegan and cruelty free! I apply daily as the last step in my morning skincare routine. Highly recommend!

This is my new favorite sunscreen! It's lightweight and I love wearing it both with and without makeup. It My skin looks hydrated and feels clean it's better than any facial sunscreen product I've ever tried! I also love the watery consistency, it's cooling on skin, and dries quickly. There is no reason to skip sunscreen with this product!
I like how it's easy to blend in and it doesn't have a sticky feeling

avis.titre: Breathable and comfortable all day! No white cast!
avis.texte: I am absolutely obsessed with The Mug Guard from Dune Suncare! This has quickly become a non-negotiable in my daily routine. It's an invisible gel formula with SPF 30 that feels incredibly lightweight and smooth. What I love most is how it protects my face while still feeling like skincare. It layers beautifully under makeup without pilling or feeling greasy, and there's no heavy sunscreen smell or white cast, just a clean, natural finish that gives my skin a healthy glow. It feels breathable and comfortable all day, which is huge for me. If you're looking for facial sun protection that actually feels good to wear every single day, The Mug Guard is it. It's a total 5-star must-have!

I am one of those people where everything makes my skin yell at me and I've tried every mineral sunscreen around because I thought that's what I was supposed to do, but this sunscreen is the only one that my skin is pleased about! So happy to have found it! Goes on really nicely, and feels clean (I forget I'm wearing it!)
one of my top sunscreens in my routine-very lightweight love it under makeup

I've been using The Mug Guard by Dune Suncare** and I love how lightweight it feels on my skin. It absorbs quickly, leaves no white cast, and sits beautifully under makeup. Beyond SPF 30 protection, it also keeps my skin hydrated and smooth throughout the day. It's one of those sunscreens I actually look forward to wearing daily. ☀️

I absolutely love the mug gaurd as my go-to spf! It layers beautifully with my skincare and makeup and doesn't make my skin feel too tight. I love that I can now use a sunscreen packed with skin-loving ingredients that leave my face feeling fresh and ready to take on my day!
My husband doesn't wear SPF. I know shameful. But the gel, cooling texture he is totally fine with. I love that it also has all these different benefits to your skin as well. Total win.

avis.titre: LOVE! Great for face and body
avis.texte: Love the mug guard!!!! Plus Dune is vegan and cruelty free and clean ingredients which is awesome. Easy to rub in and lasts alllll day. Great face and body!

avis.titre: The sunscreen you didn't know you needed
avis.texte: Truly was not expecting to enjoy it as much as I did. I really don't think i needed another sunscreen but mug guard wasn't heavy like 99% of the other sunscreens I've tried and made me feel moisturized without feeling hot. Other sunscreens have made me feel hot and sweaty like they're suffocating my skin.

This invisible gel formula completely changed my daily SPF routine. It goes on weightless, absorbs instantly, and leaves zero white cast, just smooth, hydrated skin. No pilling. No clogged pores. No greasy finish. It's water-resistant and packed with antioxidant-rich Vitamin E, and I love that it's clinically proven to help reduce the look of fine lines, wrinkles, dark spots, and redness over time. It feels more like skincare than sunscreen. Truly the kind of SPF you want to wear every single day. My skin looks healthier, smoother, and protected. Absolute staple.
Protects my skin, doesn't break me out and makes my skin look hydrated and ready for the day ... YES PLEASE

I always dread putting on face sunscreen because I can feel it sitting on top of my skin and I was very impressed by the thin lightweight formula! It does not sit on top at all which I love. Highly recommend!

I got a mini guard and I'm convinced of buying the full size because I have mild rosacea on my cheeks and when applying this, the redness went away, it's lightweight which is perfect for the climate I live.

avis.titre: Actually invisible and feels like skincare
avis.texte: I'm obsessed with how this feels on my skin!! It's completely clear and weightless. It absorbs instantly without any pilling or greasiness. It's the perfect base for my morning routine.
I have been on a hunt for a gel sunscreen for my face and the mug guard is incredible. Doesn't peel under make up either. 10/10 would recommend
This product is one of my favorite, I definitely will buy it again!

I am going to be honest, I usually HATE sunscreen. Everything feels too greasy/slimy on my skin and I almost always break out when I apply sunscreen to my face. Do not even get me started how most sunscreen ruins my makeup. This is the first time I have genuinely enjoyed a sunscreen in my routine. The Mug Guard is not greasy at all as it is a gel. I can only use gel moisturizers so this is perfect for me. My skin absorbed it quickly but it did not feel drying at all, just like an extra kiss of moisture. My favorite part about this is that my makeup applied over top of this BEAUTIFULLY. I thought I would always be a sunscreen hater, only applying it when I really was worried about a burn. Now I can wear it daily without the pimples and greasiness. I also love that it is made with clean ingredients!!!
The texture is great, very cooling gel And not a weird sunscreen smell

This is the first sunscreen I actually look forward to putting on every morning. It goes on completely clear and feels weightless, which is a total win for my oily skin. Even though the bottle is compact, the quality of the formula justifies every penny.
I tried this out in the snow and it didn't make my eyes sting (only a little at first, but my eyes are really sensitive) and went on without a cast. Will definitely keep using!

I love this sunscreen! I love that it feels lightweight on the skin & doesn't leave a white cast! I also love that it's green, which is different than other sunscreens that are usually white! My face felt protected while I had the sunscreen on!

avis.titre: Loving this invisible gel suncare product
avis.texte: I love how lightweight the product feels. I first tried out the travel size before making the decision to purchase my full size. It's not greasy at all so it won't clog your pores nor is it hard to wash off at the end of the day. Protects your skin while keeping to youthful. Amazing product overall 10/10.

I'm putting this in everyone's stocking. Idk how to tell if sunscreen works or not honestly. I will say that I love it because it does not sting! I rub my eyes and have very watery eyes and every other sunscreen stings. I also like that it is dewy and not in the shiny sunscreen way more like glass skin or just put a thick moisturizer overnight mask thing on. I like to look like I just poured water on my face even with makeup on so this is perfect for me. It also doesn't smell sunscreeny imo.

avis.titre: Best sunscreen for acne prone skin
avis.texte: This is hands down the best sunscreen I've used as someone with a darker complexion and acne prone skin. It's moisturizing without the greasy, heavy feeling usual sunscreens leave behind, and it doesnt leave any white cast.

I have sensitive skin, reactive skin, combination skin, and acne prone skin. This sunscreen is the only sunscreen I keep coming back to!! It hasn't caused break outs, doesn't clog my pores, and hasn't caused excess oil production. I also love that the green helps soothe red skin. Also, even with it only being a SPF 30 it does a great job at keeping my face from getting sunburnt even with being out in the sun all day!

avis.titre: Am I being gaslit or are these other reviews fake????
avis.texte: I really don't understand all the 4-5 star reviews. This suscreen has to be one of the worst sunscreens I've tried. It's sort of giving fake reviews but who knows 🤷‍♀️ because I have acne prone skin and this made it so much worse while I was using it. I see some people with fungal acne saying it's safe for they're skin type—yes, I understand fungal & acne prone are not the same! HOWEVER, they are very similar!! All this to say, PLEASEEE SAVE YOUR PRECIOUS MONEY ESPECIALLY IN THIS ECONOMY AND LOOK FOR ANOTHER OPTION! This sunscreen is ssa. Sorry not sorry. I just feel so gaslit by these reviews. I know that not everything is meant to work for me but ive tried other suncreens I maybe wasnt a fan of but they still did their job. This sunscreen on the other hand, did the opposite and actually cause me to breakout.

I am very prone to sunscreen moisturizers burning my eyes and have tried so many and im glad i finally tried this one. Does not burn my eyes, i wear it before long runs and when i go in the ocean. No burning. Also doesnt have a scent or a gross lingering smell like some other sunscreens which im also sensitive to. Love the texture too. Buying my second bottle now.
It's like a drink of water for my face that also protects me from harmful UV rays oh la la
For me, this is best sunscreen I have ever tried and instantly made me want to wear it daily. Light and luxurious. Delicious scent. Great for a guy.
I love how my skin feels after I use this sunscreen. Whenever I share it with someone they tend to love it

This is a great sunscreen. It does have that sunscreen smell but I quickly go nose blind to it. The claims are true! It does not pill, it's quick drying, and there is no white cast. I will say it does give me that dewy glow so if you're looking for a matte look- look elsewhere.

avis.titre: It's A No From Me, Dawg!
avis.texte: As I sit here with one eye open waiting for my bf to get back from the car with Micellar wipes, my eyes have been burning so badly for the past 2 hours (prob put it on an hour before that and it took time to "travel" to my eyes"), and I no longer can take it. I liked the feel of the formula and it rubbed in well. It's a larger size than many other bottles of face sunscreen. Thats the 2nd star. And I bougnt 2 of these. Nope. Never again.

As someone who breaks out to a lot of different skincare products, this is one of the few sunscreens that doesn't. I found no irritation around my eyes when I applied it, and it left no white cast on my medium skin! I love to buy it when its on sale.
I love that it just melts into my skin and is not white at all!
Love this--effective and no white residue. Only problem is that it stings if I get it in my eyes,

avis.titre: I never leave reviews but this changed my life
avis.texte: I own and operate a landscape business and discovered this sunscreen 2 summers ago at a local apothecary... this stuff is life changing. I first used the mug guard all over because I didn't know bodguard existed, I can wear a tank top all summer long and not get a burn I swear. Today is the first hot day of the season and I slathered all day long and I would usually be burnt to a crisp, I have a slight tank tan line. I feel so safe, moisturized, and excited to be able to wear tanks all summer without a long sleeve conniption. Seriously life changing, work changing, I couldn't recommend this product enough. I tell all of the boys in trades I run into about it. Thank you gals so much for making this product!!!!

This has been my go-to daily SPF ever since I started dealing with FA breakouts. I live in a very dry climate and find this is all the hydration I need for daytime. Lightweight feeling, doesn't pill or sting near my eyes, and plays nicely under makeup. Also layers/reapplies nicely throughout the day. Would love to eventually see a higher SPF in this same formula that's also FA-safe!
I have dark skin and trying new sunscreens don't always go so well. But with this one, it actually goes on clear! I use the small one as a hand lotion to protect my hands from the sun while driving
This used to be my ride or die sunscreen, but I recently order another bottle, and have been breaking out with every application. Did the formula get changed? I'm so sad

avis.titre: Skin seems to be softer & smoother!
avis.texte: I like it! It's a small bottle, but, I like it! I think it lives up to it's claim: my face appears to be smoother, feels softer.

avis.titre: Skin seems to be softer & smoother!
avis.texte: I like it! It's a small bottle, but, I like it! I think it lives up to it's claim: my face appears to be smoother, feels softer.
Avobenzone and Octocrylene are both banned in Hawaii for damaging the reefs.

avis.titre: Amazing and never stains my clothes
avis.texte: I love Mug Guard, I used to use a tinted sunscreen for my face, but Mug Guard goes on clear and has never once stained any of my clothes, which was not the case with any of the other brands I have tried!
Bummer that this is now 5 mL smaller than before but costs exactly the same.
Not great for sensitive skin. I love a milky SPF for layering other products but even with a heavy moisturizer underneath it dried my skin and caused peeling and flaking

avis.titre: It's the thought that counts......I guess.
avis.texte: Pros: Goes onto the face very smooth. Cons: Very strong spf smell Very greasy(Especially in the summer time or heat) Burns the eyes. Takes awhile to blend into my darker skin. Irritated my acne prone skin. Overall, I'm not really a fan of this sunscreen as a darker combination sensitive skinned, acne prone woman. This sunscreen just does not do it for me.

I go through sunscreen like its nothing because I tend to burn easily. This one is lightweight and comfortable. I wear it under makeup without any problems like some cause. The only downside is the price for the size youre getting, but otherwise I love this product and will be buying it again.
I love the texture and feel of this sunscreen and it doesn't cause acne for my very sensitive skin. Downside is it goes quickly and the price point is too high.

I have sensitive, dry skin. I'm newer to using sunscreen daily. I researched many brands and this had great reviews, so I bought it hoping for the best. Using it over my serums has helped them work their magic. My dark spots have eased up and my expression lines are less prominent. My skin is more hydrated and plump. I plan to keep using this because "if it ain't broke, don't fix it" and it works perfectly for me! Also, sometimes when I introduce a new product, my skin has a bad reaction (redness, irritation, breakout) and this sunscreen has not caused any negative reactions.

avis.titre: These reviews are lying to you
avis.texte: It is not as good as people are saying in the reviews. Yes, it blends out well but it just stays on top of your skin and leaves you with a greasy feeling. Also, for the price… definitely not worth it. I couldnt even finish the whole bottle because it was breaking me out so bad. Some people are saying its good for people with acne prone skin but as someone with acne prone skin, yeah it is not it. I gave it to a relative because i didnt want to be wasteful and even they didnt like it and theyre honestly not that picky with their skincare. Korean sunscreens are the way to go especially if youre acne prone and the prices are a lot more cheaper!
I love the texture. I'm able to use it instead of a moisturizer-I'm in my 40s and have dry skin. A little bit long way, so the bottle size is plenty.
This has been my daily sunscreen since the start of this year and don't plan on changing anytime soon!

The Mug Guard has been my favorite sun protection facial product for several years. My skin is sensitive and acne prone, and The Mug Guard has not caused irritation nor breakouts. I use it as my daytime moisturizer. Before discovering The Mug Guard, I spent a lot of money in search of an affordable sunscreen that lived up to its hype. The Mug Guard does, to my delight!!!

Best skinfeel I've ever had with a spf! I'm into spf my whole life and trust me I've tried at least 50 subscreen products so far, from cheap brands to luxurious, asian brands, tropical island local brands, etc etc. i must say dune's texture is my favorite! I have a very sensitive skin and have ruined my face real bad once after long hours snorkeling so I'm very serious when it comes to sunscreen. I wouldn't use dune in ocean cause technically most chemical ingredients are not good for marine biome but your recipe is really impressive for a land use spf! I just hope you make a spf 50 version for face sunscreen though cause sometimes even spf 30 will damage my skin visibly.

This is the acne friendly spf out there. I workout outside everyday in FL, so finding an SPF that was water and sweat resistant was important. I have tried so many, but thankfully I found this one. I've had so many bad breakouts from SPFs that claimed to be acne safe but this one actually is.

I'm usually a mineral sunscreen girlie because they don't irritate my eyes, I avoided chemical spfs for ages because they'd sting! But this spf doesn't sting at all, infact it's very gentle on my sensitive skin. It applies smoothly, no white cast at all, and sinks in after about 30 or so minutes. It's not greasy but does leave a dewy finish. Not much scent, but there is a subtle "sunscreeny" smell to it.

I was looking for a travel sized set of sunblock to take on vacation in January and stumbled upon Dune. The fact it was gel was a huge influence and I bought the set. Its pretty amazing. It works into the skin nicely and doesnt leave my hands super sticky afterwards like some lotions do. We ended up using all 3–the Mug Guard (face), Bod Guard (body) and Life Guard (after burn). I just repurchased this full size Mug Guard (this is kind of a misnomer, as its only 2.2 oz) as its the one I use the most. As a caveat, depending on what you have on your face, it *can* leave somewhat of a white cast. Most of the time I'm fine, but there have been occasions where, depending on what moisturizer/serums I use, it does leave a bit of white on there. Its not enough to make me stop using it, but its good to keep in mind. Otherwise, I love the way it absorbs and how it feels.

avis.titre: Not happy- Read Label Chemical UV
avis.texte: Initially i thought this would work for me. I lived the fact that it was clear and felt it woudl absorb quickly too. However, having a recent health issue, i was disappointed to find Chemical UV Filters listed in the ingredients. My Dr. mentioned these filters mimic estrogen and can wreak havic with your endocrine system. So unfortunately I cannot risk using this lotion.

I was so pleasantly surprised by this sunscreen. I have extremely sensitive skin, acne, rosacea, eczema, you name it. Finding a sunscreen that doesnt cause a reaction felt impossible but alas sunscreen is a necessity. I took a chance on this when it was on sale because of the glowing reviews truthfully not expecting much other than an overpriced basic sunscreen. I am happy to admit I was wrong. I LOVE this sunscreen. It goes on so well, never breaks my skin out with rashes or acne, and reapplies without becoming a mess. I have started using this on my kids too. I came back to order more and leave this review. The bottle is small but it spreads out very well. 10/10 RECOMMEND if your skin cant tolerate most drug store brands.

avis.titre: The best Chemical Sunscreen - SAFE for SENSITIVE SKIN
avis.texte: I bought the Dune Mug Guard on a whim on sale at another store. It's now my holy grail. I had seen so many instagram ads and became curious. I've been wearing it everyday for a month and am so in love with this product. I have very sensitive skin, rosacea, and psoriasis. My skin hasnt looked this good in years, let alone felt this good wearing a sunscreen. It melts in beautifully, gives a lovely glow, and is long lasting. If youre not careful and get it too close to your eye opening, you could experience some burning but that is typical of any American chemical UV filter. After my month of use I think I've only gotten it near my eye twice where it cause a tiny sting and I washed it away quickly. Not a strong enough reason to rate it poorly. I've had other friends try out this sunscreen and they love how it feels and doesn't have that sunscreen smell.

ive been searching and searching for a good spf….and here it is. ive tried it once, today actually, and got several compliment on my skin today! I have dry/sensitive skin so the fact that i didnt have trouble introducing this into my skin care routine nor any breakouts is everything 🤌🏽🤌🏽

I have been trying to find the perfect spf for almost 6 months. I think I've finally found the perfect one 😍 absolutely shocked how good this looks under makeup. It makes your makeup flawless with a natural finish. I'm extremely picky and this stuff is the best.

i am usually not one to leave reviews for products but i truly believe that everyone should buy this! especially girls with dry/combo skin—it leaves your skin with such a nice hydrated glow throughout the day. my co-worker complimented my skin for the first time after wearing this product. I also love how the green neutralizes my skin tone and it sits perfectly under makeup. Thank you dune!!
I am shocked at the glow this gives without anything sparkly added. The texture is super lightweight and not greasy. I will be ordering more for my face AND body.

avis.titre: why is the bottle so small ?
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen but why is it almost 30 dollars for such a small bottle? I love that this sunscreen doesn't peel and doesn't leave a white cast on my face but why so expensive?

avis.titre: BEST american sunscreen for combo skin
avis.texte: I've frequently used chemical and mineral sunscreens from asia and the US and by far this is my favorite sunscreen that you can easily get your hands on in the US. It's absolutely wonderful in terms of texture, never burns or irritates my sensitive skin, doesn't pill and doesn't have fragrance nor other ingredients I like to stay away from. I only hope Dune makes an spf 50 product for the face one day as I highly prefer spf 50 products. If you ever need a tester Dune HMU!!!

avis.titre: Love this, big win in our house
avis.texte: I think it feels great going on. The chemical sunscreen smell that others complain of is pretty faint for me and goes away quickly. I got this for my husband who refuses to wear anything that leaves a white cast and doesn't remember to ever use moisturizer, and he loves it. Big win there. Also, I love that it comes in a size you can fly with. My skin is fairly reactive and I've had zero problems with this! It's twice the amount in a bottle of my other bougie sunscreen that I use and half the price of said smaller bottle. We live in CO and SPF is a daily must, this is so so easy to just put on in the am and have everything in one.

EVERY sunscreen breaks me out or itritates my skin, so im very hesitant to try new products. However, this sunscreen so far has not broken me out (a miracle). I do experience a very mild burning sensation on the delicate areas of my face, but nothing compared to other sunscreens. I also agree with another reviewer - this did cause some burning in my eyes.
Sorry Dune. It burns my eyes. Very pricy. Very small bottle. The bottle top comes loose on its own all the time. Feels wonderful though (if you don't put it near your eyes). Very disappointing.
This sunscreen is light weight and goes on smooth. It comes in a cute bottle too! But…wouldnt recommend to wear on days you might sweat. It made my eyes burn a bit. Other than that, i like it!

I like the gel texture and I think the finish on my skin is nice. I'm not super excited about the strong chemical sunscreen smell. Given the smell I'm pleasantly surprised the sunscreen doesn't burn my eyes.

Ive struggled really hard in the past to get into using sunscreen everyday especially on my face because i would always break out from others. This one however is a game changer. The formula is super lightweight and does not clog my pores or cause me to break out. It soaks into the skin nicely so it doesnt leave a white cast and it feels good in my skin. It doesnt feel like im using sunscreen but like im using skincare products. It is worth every penny if you have problems with breaking out from sunscreen because this one does NOT.

I really like this sunscreen. However, the price for 2.2 ounces isn't something I like. If you apply the amount of sunscreen you actually need to protect your skin from the sun, this little bottle will be gone in a couple weeks. I don't know if I'll repurachse it because of that.

I've only tried this product a few times but I absolutely love how it feels on application and throughout the day. It doesn't pill or get sticky, and I love the greenish tint. I have to keep using it to see if it ends up breaking me out (most sunscreens do) but so far it's lovely to use! I don't dread reapplication!
My sensitive, reactive skin has no problem with this. It has barely any scent (faint sunscreen right at the beginning) and works well under makeup.
This sunscreen is the holy grail of sunscreens. It feels like a serum. It baaarely has a sunscreen smell and it makes your skin look so hydrated and glowy. I cannot rec

I truly feel like I've found my favorite facial sunscreen. I've tried everything from sun bum, cerave, murad, kinship and no many other brands who carry facial SPF. DUNE is my absolute FAVORITE though. I'm on my third bottle. The gel-like consistency makes for easy application, perfect wear underneath your makeup, lighweight enough for daily wear AND non pore clogging (coming from someone with combo/ ace prone skin living in humid AF south Louisiana). Ulta, please never stop carrying this!!!!

This is my holy grail every day facial sunscreen! Doesn't pill under makeup and I've had no issues with it while I'm wearing my mask at the hospital. I needed a cruelty free alternative to my old fave LRP and this blows LRP out of the water

This is by far the best sunscreen I've used where 'sunscreen as moisturizer' has never been easier. After and cleanse and serum, I can hydrated and ready to go. If I wanted to use a cream moisturizer, this gel formula is still light enough where I don't feel that I have layers caked onto my face. The green tint does wonders to enhance all lovely tones a ease redness. I've put this on, gone for coffee and received compliments on my complexion - I think people want to know what I use for makeup, but it's just this spf. I also love that there's NO PILLING - again, adding to the ease of this spf. I look forward to using this everyday and really, that's the secret to using and being the best sunscreen for you. One you'll actually want to put on. I love and recommend it to EVERYONE.
It's the best! Like feel on my face and leaves no white marks. The protection against the sun is good.

Used it for the first time this morning and I'm already hooked. Seriously so good! No SPF has ever been this comfy and soothing on my rosacea/sensitive skin. I'm so happy to finally find a SPF that I actually look forward to using daily.

I did really like this product at first, it applied nicely and left a glowy finish with no white cast, my makeup applied well over it, However after about two days of use my face broke out EVERYWHERE. I have at least 10 new pimples across my mouth, chin, forehead, eyebrows, and jawline. :( I do have slightly acne prone skin but nothing has ever made me break out so badly all at once. This is the only change I made in my routine and after discontinuing use of the product for a few days my skin has started to calm down so the sunscreen has to be the culprit. Two stars because I would love the product if it were actually viable for use on my skin but as it stands I wasted my money unfortunately.

I truly can't say enough enough good things. I purchased on a whim during a sale because I feel like I've been on a years long search for a daily SPF that doesn't burn my eyes. I fell in love after the first application, it left my severely dry skin Dewey for HOURS. And i love the smell. 10/10 for sure. I just bought the body sunscreen and I'm super excited to try it!
I had been looking for a new spf after being disappointed by supergoop and its dupes so i tried dune and fell in love! Its such a nice facial sunscreen, ive already bought two!!

Finally, I've found a daily sundcreen I love and am excited to put on every day! I have dry, sensitive skin and am prone to redness. I also have an acute sense of smell and can't stand the mineral/chemical smell of most fragrance-free sunscreens- that's always my dealbreaker. Let me just say, this stuff is amazing. It's a wonderfully moisturizing gel that absorbs well into my skin, doesn't break me out, and no gross smell! It's comparable to an aloe-like gel and feels very soothing when applying. I'm so happy with it and I hope this review helps someone that has similar struggles when it comes to finding the right daily sunscreen. I'm looking forward to trying their other products now. Get it, you won't regret it.

avis.titre: ULTA!!! PLEASE, NEVER GET RID OF THIS PRODUCT!!!
avis.texte: I have been searching for the perfect SPF/moisturizer duo for my very oily and very dehydrated skin. I hate layering a moisturizer AND an SPF, SPF moisturizers are usually too heavy and/or don't sink into my skin, and I hadn't found a good SPF to go under makeup without making the base break apart from the excess oil. THE DAYS OF THESE FRUSTRATIONS ARE OVER! Pairing this with a niacinamide serum underneath has been the answer to all my woes. If you have oily skin that also feels weirdly tight (thank you constant AC and indoor heating), I would bet money that you'd love this too!

The best thing about this product is it did not bother my skin. I have sensitive skin and I'm prone to redness, but this went on easy! It even has a green tint which I feel like helped with my redness. I like the consistency of it; it isn't thick like sunscreen, but it also isn't watery. Went on great under makeup! The smell was mild and underwhelming, which I prefer since I usually go for fragrance free products. I would definitely recommend this facial lotion for everyday coverage. Maybe not day at the beach, but this spf is great for going out and about.

My husband and I both love this product! He is obsessed with how it feels, absorbs and even better the value! I have tried a huge selection of the competitors out there. Thanks for making our new favorite sun products. -2 Southern California residents :)

avis.titre: Great face sunscreen for acne/sensitive skin
avis.texte: I thought this was a great face sunscreen for acne prone and/or sensitive skin. It does not leave any white cast as the product is green, thin and almost oily, but it doesn't leave the skin oily. It provides much more of a glow than an oily appearance which is very nice. It also is fragrance free, which I personally prefer of my skincare. All and all a great product.

I was skeptical about this product when I was first selected to review it. As an African American woman it is hard to come by sunscreens that don't leave a white cast on the skin. I had never heard of this brand before and it wasn't particularly marketed to quell the concerns I had about a cast being left. All of those worries disappeared when I applied the product! The product is gel like and absorbed so well in my skin when applied to my face and neck. It is not sticky at all and wears well under makeup as well. Wearing it by itself leaves the skin with a healthy glow. I really love the dewy finish. Will definitely be purchasing again and hope that they release another option with a higher SPF.

I thought the presentation of the bottle was very aesthetic looking, however it was quite hard to read the ingrediants and description of the product as the font was very small. I also thought that the bottle was very small (if this is the typical size of the product I would be unsatisfied with the quantity. Regarding the quality of the product itself, I think that this had a great application that went on smooth and was easy to rub in. I did notice that the product was slightly sticky and made my face a bit more greasy as the day went on, more than usual. I think the smell was very nice, however I think when applying something to my face I prefer something with no scent. Overall, this is a good product for people with dry skin who are looking for light protection, otherwise I would focus on alternative products.

avis.titre: Such a nice and refreshing facial sunscreen!
avis.texte: I wanted to use this multiple times before leaving a review to ensure it was doing what I hoped. I have dry skin and not only did this provide me with SPF but I also felt that it provided more hydration. It left my skin feeling soft and light weight while other face spf leave a greasy residue. I'm very happy with this product and would buy it again. I received this product for free in exchange for a review.
I have sensitive, acne prone skin, this is the only sunscreen that hasn't broken me out. Been using it for two weeks and I love it. Mousturizing, no white cast. Will definitely continue purchasing.

I'm obsessed with this sunscreen. I've been wanting to buy a new sunscreen so I was super excited when I saw this. Most sunscreens I've tried leave a white cast, which I hate, but when i tried this on it did not leave a white cast it was also super light weight. I would buy this product again and recommend it to others!!

Ever since I was a kid, I've hated applying liquid sunscreen. My mom had to switch to the spray and with my kids I use the stick. I was hesitant to use this at first based on the fact that it was liquid. However, when I apply it to my skin... It doesn't feel thick or leave a film. It honestly feels as if I'm just applying a moisturizer. Once it sets on my skin, I cannot even tell it's there. I have noticed that my skin no longer gets dried during the day and now I know I'm protecting it from the sun. I do wish it was a higher SPF because I'm so fair, but it did its job.
This is a nice product. It goes on easily and leaves a very smooth finish. It's not too heavy and lays very nicely under my makeup. Definitely a fan
